calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, min(business_date) mn, max(business_date) mx
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) ctl_before, SUM(r.returns_net) ctl_ret
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' chk, count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line', count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', count(*) - count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_not_900', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_without_dispatch', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected') WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups USING(receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 30

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups USING(receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT status, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_dispatch, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx,
  sum(CASE WHEN web_order_id IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_lines
FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-08-20' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-12-25' GROUP BY 1
